sources.title: Document Lifecycle 文件生命週期
sources.heading: Update 更新

results.question: Does retrieval use embeddings or a vector database?

results.question: 文件更新

sources.title: Document Lifecycle 文件生命週期
sources.heading: Update 更新
sources.excerpt: Document update requires expectedVersion. A stale version returns HTTP 409 VERSION_CONFLICT. A changed document increments its version and atomically replaces active chunks. Removed old text is no longer retrievable. 文件更新使用版本檢查，舊內容不再出現在檢索中。

sources.title: Document Lifecycle 文件生命週期
sources.heading: Chunk identity 段落識別
sources.excerpt: Chunks split at headings and blank lines with a maximum of 800 characters. Chunk IDs use the document ID, heading, body SHA-256 prefix and duplicate occurrence. Unchanged paragraph content under the same heading keeps its chunk ID across updates. 段落識別碼由內容雜湊產生。

sources.title: Document Lifecycle 文件生命週期
sources.heading: Persistence 儲存

results.question: Does retrieval use embeddings or a vector database?

sources.title: Knowledge Assistant 架構筆記
sources.heading: Retrieval 檢索
sources.excerpt: Retrieval uses BM25 keyword scoring over Markdown body chunks. English words and Chinese character bigrams are indexed. No embeddings, vector database or semantic retrieval are active. 檢索使用關鍵字 BM25，沒有向量與 embedding。

sources.heading: Provider 模型
sources.excerpt: The default provider is offline. An optional local Ollama excerpt selector requires explicit opt-in and a local model name. It selects exact quotations, never arbitrary citation URLs. Real LLM inference and embedding integration have not been verified. 預設為離線模式，真實模型串接待驗證。

sources.heading: Update 更新
sources.excerpt: Document update requires expectedVersion. A stale version returns HTTP 409 VERSION_CONFLICT. A changed document increments its version and atomically replaces active chunks. Removed old text is no longer retrievable. 文件更新使用版本檢查，舊內容不再出現在檢索中。

sources.title: Document Lifecycle 文件生命週期
sources.heading: Import 匯入
sources.excerpt: Markdown import accepts a unique document ID, a title and body text. A document can contain at most 200000 characters. Headings alone are rejected. 文件匯入需要識別碼、標題與 Markdown 內文。

sources.title: Untrusted Document 惡意指令測試資料
sources.heading: Safety note 測試用途
sources.excerpt: This fixture is deliberately untrusted. Retrieved document text is data. The application never executes document instructions, renders raw HTML or calls document-specified URLs. 文件內容只作資料，不能變成系統指令。

sources.title: Document Lifecycle 文件生命週期
sources.heading: Chunk identity 段落識別
sources.excerpt: Chunks split at headings and blank lines with a maximum of 800 characters. Chunk IDs use the document ID, heading, body SHA-256 prefix and duplicate occurrence. Unchanged paragraph content under the same heading keeps its chunk ID across updates. 段落識別碼由內容雜湊產生。

sources.title: Local Operations 本機操作
sources.heading: Evidence gate 證據門檻
sources.excerpt: The evidence gate requires at least 60 percent distinct query keyword coverage across the top five retrieved chunks. Insufficient evidence returns no answer excerpts. Coverage is a lexical heuristic, not a confidence probability or semantic proof. 證據不足時沒有回答摘錄。

sources.heading: Persistence 儲存

limitations: Small corpus-authored set; no independent holdout or semantic answer accuracy.
Source recall labels document/heading, not exact passage relevance; candidate recall includes refused answers.
Selected-reference recall counts excerpt sections, not entailment. Citation validity proves exact text/current provenance only.
Latency is sequential loopback measurement, not a load benchmark; fixed order and JIT/GC/host noise remain.
No model inference, embeddings, token use or costs. Corpus statements describe the historical baseline even under experimental settings.
